description: VegScape—Vegetation Condition Explorer is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by George Mason University | Center for Spatial Information and Science Systems; NASA, National Aeronautics and Space Administration; USDA National Agricultural Statistics Service. Check daily, weekly, or biweekly data on the health of crops across the contiguous U.S. The data come from NASA’s Moderate Resolution Imaging Spectroradiometer (MODIS) instrument aboard NASA’s Terra and Aqua satellites. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Changing Seasons, Drought, Extreme Cold, Extreme Heat, Flooding – General, Shifting Species, Habitats, and Ecosystems, Vector-Borne Disease. Assets: Agriculture and Food Supply, Forestry, Natural Areas and Wildlife, Urban Landscape and Tree Canopy. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
